citation.authors: Del Rosario E, Florez-Pollack S, Zapata L et al
citation.journal: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology

record.population: 44 people with moderate-to-severe melasma, mostly Hispanic women, single centre
record.design: Randomised, placebo-controlled trial of oral tranexamic acid for 3 months, with sunscreen
record.finding: Melasma severity score fell 49% on tranexamic acid and 18% on placebo at 3 months; 3 months after stopping the gap had narrowed (26% against 19% from baseline). No serious adverse events.
record.note: Predominantly Hispanic women, per its own limitations line. Tranexamic acid is a prescription medicine.
